decision: Stop this row-plane matrix optimization/state-transport branch, including both reset controls; no second bank, learning-rate sweep, moment compensation or counter variants.
reason: Transport is below strong bilateral in both orders and loses on average to the matched matrix-reset control. Full-matrix reset does not improve over diagonal reset on average. Both reset arms reverse their effect versus bilateral across orders, with near-zero order-average differences. The extra215031824bytes of persistent transport history do not buy a stable performance benefit.
mechanism_observation: The implemented old/new row basis, matrix second moments, exact represented-state transport and native export pass independent audits. This verifies the tested operator, not the sufficiency of its retained history or a general impossibility for optimization-state transport. Changing row coordinates plus FP64 Adam-type reset also fails to establish a stable advantage.
scope: One exposed development bank, two correlated arrival orders. Task-deletion ranges are sensitivity, not confidence intervals; no new minimum performance threshold. Generic full-matrix preconditioning and basis-overlap transport have prior art.
next: Reassess the method search using the accumulated direct evidence and existing algorithm boundaries; select a concrete next operator only after identifying what information or computation it adds beyond the closed coefficient/history/optimizer branches.
